title: Solving x^2 + 2x = 4
summary: Use completing the square to solve a quadratic equation.

blocks.body: We want to solve x^2 + 2x = 4. The goal is to turn the left side into one squared expression.
Take half of the coefficient of x, then square it. Half of 2 is 1, and 1 squared is 1. Add 1 to both sides.
Take the positive and negative square roots. Both signs are needed because both  sqrt(5) and -sqrt(5) square to 5.

blocks.title: Check the result
blocks.body: Substituting either value into x^2 + 2x gives 4. The two solutions are approximately x = 1.236 and x = -3.236.
